sloka: ध्रुवं तु भरतं रामः प्राप्य राज्यमकण्टकम् ।देशान्तरं वासयिता लोकान्तरमथापि व ॥२-८-२७॥
transliteration: dhruvaṁ tu bharataṁ rāmaḥ prāpya rājyamakaṇṭakam ।deśāntaraṁ vāsayitā lokāntaramathāpi va ॥2-8-27॥

translations.english: Rama, having secured the thornless kingdom, will banish Bharata from the country or else send him to the other world. This is certain.
